description: Mysios Labs is a consultancy site whose owner also publishes nazca, a thin CLI for generating AI images, video, speech, and 3D assets. Nazca routes prompts to supported model providers such as Vertex AI, fal.ai, ModelArk, OpenAI, Atlas Cloud, and Worder.
summary: mysioslabs.com declares and documents one developer integration surface: the `nazca` CLI, installed from GitHub, with auth via Google Cloud ADC for Vertex by default plus optional fal.ai, ByteDance ModelArk, OpenAI, Atlas Cloud, and Worder keys.

packages.runtimeHint: uv tool install "git+https://github.com/Mysios-Labs-inc/nazca.git@v0.1.0" or pipx install from Git
